✳ MEET THE BAKER

Haifa Thasneem

I’m the home baker behind The CakeFairy. I bake celebration cakes by pre-order in Somwarpet, Kodagu.

Have a gathering coming up? Tell me what you have in mind, how many people you’re feeding, and when you’d like your cake.

✳ BEFORE YOU ORDER

A few good
questions

How do I enquire about a cake?

Choose a cake from the gallery or menu to start a WhatsApp draft. Include your preferred pickup date, cake size, and any design ideas. You can also message me directly using the WhatsApp button.

How do I arrange pickup?

Share your preferred date on WhatsApp. I’ll confirm availability and share pickup details in Somwarpet.

Can I request something off the menu?

Add your idea in the enquiry notes. Flavour, serving size, and occasion are helpful details to include.

What if I have a food allergy?

Ask the baker directly about ingredients and cross-contact before placing an order.
